text.en: Most dog owners praise trainer Josh and the team for their deep knowledge, structured curriculum, and dedication to obedience. However, a couple of reviewers report negative interactions during initial consultations, describing communication as aggressive or rude. While many handlers feel supported, a few clients were uncomfortable with the direct sales style.

Clients frequently report noticeable behavioral transformations in high-energy dogs, including AmStaffs, Labs, and hunting breeds. Handlers highlight dramatic progress in off-leash reliability, polite heel walking, and passing Canine Good Citizen evaluations. Owners emphasize that the structured methods deliver dependable results in public environments.

Reviewers note that trainers understand canine psychology and manage strong, easily distracted dogs effectively. Owners appreciate the safe environment maintained during large group classes, allowing pets to practice off-leash socialization with proper supervision. Handlers feel confident that their dogs learn reliable focus around outdoor distractions.

q.en: Does Houston DogWorks offer group training classes?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently participate in structured group classes and social sessions alongside private lessons.

q.en: Can trainers prepare dogs for the Canine Good Citizen test?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers note successfully preparing for and passing the AKC Canine Good Citizen evaluation.

q.en: Do programs cover off-leash obedience and field retrieval?

a.en: Yes, handlers report solid progress with off-leash control, gundog training, and dependable retrieving.
